name: webx-ui/widgets
description: The interactive pieces every site repeats — menus, dialogs, tabs, accordions, cookie consent and, next, sliders, video and maps — with their logic and accessibility done and their look left to the theme, loaded only on the pages that use them.

suggest.webx-ui/module-inbox: Its forms opened in a dialog by any button (data-webx-form="<slug>")
suggest.webx-ui/module-settings: The "Cookie" tab of the settings screen and MCP for the consent banner, without it config/webx-widgets.php; the Contacts tab the phones, hours, quick contact and networks read
suggest.webx-ui/routing: The language switcher's addresses of the same page in the other languages (with webx-ui/localization)
